s: The 'Vidya Vahini' digital learning portal launched in Andhra Pradesh on National Education Day 2026 is an initiative of which body?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
x: APSCHE launched Vidya Vahini on 11 Nov 2026 (National Education Day) under its LMS-MOOCs initiative.

s:
Consider the following about the 'Vidya Vahini' portal (Nov 2026):
1. Its first courses include Introduction to AI, Applications of AI and Quantum Technology.
2. Each course is a four-credit course of 40 modules.
3. It was launched on 14 November, Children's Day.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: Three courses (AI intro, AI applications, Quantum Technology), each four-credit with 40 modules; it was launched on 11 November, National Education Day, not 14 November.

s: The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE), described as the first such State council in India, was established in
x: APSCHE was set up on 20 May 1988 under the APSCHE Act, 1988, following the NPE 1986.

s: In November 2026 the Andhra Pradesh CM ordered the restoration of how many defunct lift irrigation schemes at about ₹632 crore?
x: 789 defunct LIS to be restored at ₹632.07 crore before the next Kharif; Jalaharathi Corporation to maintain them.

s:
Consider the following about 'Mana Mitra' of Andhra Pradesh:
1. It is a WhatsApp-based governance platform launched in January 2025.
2. It was launched by Nara Lokesh.
3. It started with 500 services.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: Mana Mitra was launched on 30 Jan 2025 by Nara Lokesh with 161 services (200 by March 2025).

s: The 'Vayo Samman Rashtriya Abhiyan' launched in November 2026 is a
o: Health insurance card drive for citizens above 70 under PM-JAY
Pension top-up scheme under PM Vriddhavastha Pension Yojana
Digital literacy mission for senior citizens under ULLAS
National Intergenerational Bonding Campaign under the Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana
x: Launched by MoSJE Minister Dr Virendra Kumar as a National Intergenerational Bonding Campaign under AVYAY.

s: The 'Vayo Samman Rashtriya Abhiyan' follows a '5C' model. Which of the following is NOT one of the five Cs?
x: The 5Cs are Connect, Converse, Co-create, Contribute and Continue.

s: The Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana, which gives assisted-living devices to senior citizens, is a
o: Centrally Sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Health, begun in 2015
Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, begun in 2017
Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development, begun in 1995
State scheme of Andhra Pradesh begun in 2019
x: RVY: 1 April 2017, Central Sector, MoSJE; now a component of AVYAY.

s:
With reference to the change in the Agnipath scheme (Nov 2026), consider:
1. Agniveers not retained after four years get an additional two years of service.
2. Seva Nidhi contribution during the first four years is 50:50 between Agniveer and Government.
3. For exits after the additional two years, the Government pays 70% of the Seva Nidhi corpus.
Which of the above are correct?
x: All three: extra 2 years for the 75%, 50:50 Seva Nidhi in the first 4 years, Government 70% for later exits.

s: Which district became India's first notified Organic Fisheries Cluster under PMMSY (Nov 2026)?
x: Soreng (Sikkim) – India's first notified Organic Fisheries Cluster under PMMSY; an SOP for organic certification of fisheries in the North-East was launched.

s: The Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, which had reached over 35 crore people by November 2026, was launched on
o: 2 October 2019 by the Ministry of Health
26 June 2018 by the Ministry of Home Affairs
15 August 2020 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
15 August 2022 by the Narcotics Control Bureau
x: NMBA: MoSJE, 15 Aug 2020, flagship of NAPDDR; 35.84 crore people reached as on 10 Nov 2026.

s:
With reference to the Fast Track Special Courts scheme continued by the Cabinet in November 2026, consider:
1. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme continued from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031.
2. It deals with rape cases and cases under the POCSO Act, 2012.
3. It is administered by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: FTSC is a CSS of the Ministry of Law and Justice (not MHA), continued for 2026-31, for rape and POCSO cases.

s: The Central share of the continued Fast Track Special Courts scheme (2026-31) is funded from the
x: Central share ₹2,353.15 crore of ₹3,788.04 crore comes from the Nirbhaya Fund (2013, non-lapsable).

s:
With reference to the VGF scheme for grid-scale energy storage approved on 4 November 2026, consider:
1. Its outlay is ₹14,500 crore for 92 GWh of storage.
2. Pumped hydro forms the largest part (60 GWh) of the target.
3. Battery storage projects must have 40% domestic content.
Which of the above are correct?
x: ₹14,500 crore VGF for 92 GWh = 60 GWh pumped hydro + 30 GWh BESS + 2 GWh other; 40% DCR for BESS.

s: VISTAR, a ₹4,371 crore Central Sector Scheme approved in November 2026, will be implemented by which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Home Affairs (Office of the RGI)
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
x: VISTAR = Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research; MoSPI; surveys 43 to 59; 8th Economic Census.

s: Under the VISTAR scheme (2026-27 to 2030-31), which edition of the Economic Census is to be conducted?
x: VISTAR funds the 8th Economic Census and raises national surveys from 43 to 59.

s: In November 2026 the Union Cabinet continued the Stand-Up India scheme up to
x: Stand-Up India continued till 31 March 2031 with a ₹4,111 crore credit guarantee corpus; target 2.5 lakh more entrepreneurs.

s:
Consider the following about the Stand-Up India scheme:
1. It facilitates bank loans of above ₹10 lakh up to ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises.
2. Each bank branch is to lend to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower.
3. It covers only manufacturing units.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: Loans ₹10 lakh–₹1 crore, one SC/ST and one woman per branch; eligible sectors include manufacturing, services, trading and agri-allied, so 3 is wrong.

s: The Union Cabinet on 11 November 2026 approved a subsidy for phosphatic and potassic (P&K) fertilisers for Rabi 2026-27 of about
x: P&K subsidy for Rabi 2026-27 = ₹62,370 crore (₹37,952.29 crore was the Rabi 2025-26 figure).

s: The 'Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum' cleared by the Cabinet (₹3,230 crore) will come up at
o: North and South Block complex, New Delhi
x: It is planned at the North and South Block complex and is to have the world's largest display area; Lothal hosts the NMHC.

s: Semicon 2.0, whose web application portal was launched in November 2026, has an outlay of
x: Semicon 2.0: Cabinet 15 July 2026, MeitY, ₹1,27,500 crore, six pillars; ISM 1.0 had ₹76,000 crore.

s:
Match the programme with its outlay:
A. India Semiconductor Mission 1.0 - 1. ₹1,27,500 crore
B. Semicon 2.0 - 2. ₹76,000 crore
C. VGF for grid-scale storage - 3. ₹14,500 crore
D. VISTAR - 4. ₹4,371.10 crore
x: ISM 1.0 ₹76,000 crore; Semicon 2.0 ₹1,27,500 crore; storage VGF ₹14,500 crore; VISTAR ₹4,371.10 crore.

s:
Consider the following about the PLI scheme for Medical Devices (PLI-MD):
1. It is run by the Department of Pharmaceuticals.
2. It has been extended up to 2035-36.
3. The incentive is 5% of incremental sales of goods made in India.
Which of the above are correct?
x: PLI-MD: Department of Pharmaceuticals, launched 2020-21, extended to 2035-36, ~₹2,700 crore for fresh applications, 5% of incremental sales.

s: Under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, the maximum central subsidy for a residential rooftop plant above 3 kW is
x: Subsidy ₹30,000–60,000 for 1–2 kW, ₹60,000–78,000 for 2–3 kW, capped at ₹78,000 above 3 kW (MNRE, Feb 2024).

s: Under the Model Solar Village component of PM Surya Ghar, a candidate revenue village (in a non-special-category State) must have a population of over
x: One Model Solar Village per district; population above 5,000 (2,000 in special category States).

s: Who was appointed Chairperson of the Andhra Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (APERC) on 4 November 2026?
x: Retired IAS officer Binoy Kumar succeeded P. Venkata Rama Reddy; term 5 years or till age 70.

s:
Consider the following about APERC:
1. It was set up on 31 March 1999 under the Andhra Pradesh Electricity Reform Act, 1998.
2. It consists of a Chairperson and two Members.
3. It is a constitutional body under Article 243.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: APERC is a statutory body (AP Electricity Reform Act 1998), est. 31 Mar 1999, Chairperson + 2 Members – not constitutional.

s: P. Chandrasekhar was appointed in November 2026 to the AP Higher Education Fee Regulatory and Monitoring Committee as the representative of
o: All India Council for Technical Education
x: He is the NMC representative on APHEFRMC for 3 years; the body was set up on 19 Aug 2019 under the AP Higher Education Regulatory and Monitoring Commission Act, 2019.

s: As per Section 4(1) of the NMC Act, 2019, the National Medical Commission consists of how many members?
x: 33 = Chairperson + 10 ex officio + 22 part-time members.

s: The AP JAC Amaravati, which in November 2026 urged the 12th Pay Revision Commission to report within six months, was formed in 2017 at
x: AP JAC Amaravati – formed 5 Feb 2017 at Tirupati; Chairman Bopparaju Venkateswarlu.

s: In the Access (In)Equality Index 2026, which State ranked first, with Andhra Pradesh second?
x: Goa 1st (0.68), Andhra Pradesh 2nd (0.66), Sikkim 3rd.

s:
Consider the following about the Access (In)Equality Index 2026:
1. It is prepared by the Centre for New Economic Studies, O.P. Jindal Global University.
2. Andhra Pradesh ranked first in the socio-economic security dimension.
3. It is prepared by NITI Aayog using 84 indicators.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: AEI is by CNES (OPJGU) with 60 indicators in 23 categories; AP 1st in socio-economic security (0.69). NITI's 84-indicator index is the Investment Friendliness Index.

s: Which State topped the Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (Nov 2026) prepared by IndiaTech.org with Consumer VOICE?
x: AP first for smooth used-vehicle transfer, followed by Kerala and Tamil Nadu; UP last.

s: Swachh Survekshan 2025-26, whose awards were presented in November 2026, is which edition of the survey?
x: 10th edition (launched 2016 by MoHUA); 60 national awards given by President Murmu at Vigyan Bhawan on 11 Nov 2026.

s: Which city of Andhra Pradesh was among the top three Clean Cities of the Super Swachh League in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
x: Super Swachh League top three: Navi Mumbai, Surat, Vijayawada.

s:
Match the Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 category with an Andhra Pradesh winner:
A. Super Swachh League top three - 1. Greater Visakhapatnam (GVMC)
B. Million-plus city top three - 2. Tirupati–Kuppam
C. Swachh Shehar Jodi top three - 3. Vijayawada
x: Vijayawada – Super Swachh League; GVMC – million-plus (with Jabalpur, Lucknow); Tirupati (mentor)–Kuppam (mentee) – Swachh Shehar Jodi.

s: In Andhra Pradesh's PHC patient-satisfaction assessment (Nov 2026), which district ranked first?
x: Palnadu 1st (81.6%); Kurnool last (69.5%).

s:
Consider the following about the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2027:
1. No Indian institution is in the top 50 for the second year running.
2. IIT Delhi is the highest-ranked Indian institution.
3. The number of Indian institutions ranked fell from 325 to 294.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: IIT Delhi is India's best at 66th; Indian entries rose from 294 to 325, so 3 is wrong.

s: As per the SRS Statistical Report 2024, India's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) was
x: TFR 1.9 (rural 2.1, urban 1.5); Bihar highest at 2.9.

s:
Assertion (A): The Supreme Court in November 2026 said laws penalising having more than two children have lost relevance.
Reason (R): The SRS Statistical Report 2024 put India's TFR at 1.9, below replacement level.
Choose the correct option.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
x: The Court linked the loss of relevance to the falling fertility rate; SRS 2024 TFR = 1.9.

s: The report 'The Participation Paradox: Women's Work and Time-Use in India', released in November 2026, was prepared by
x: ICRIER report using PLFS and Time Use Survey data.

s:
As per ICRIER's 'The Participation Paradox' (2017-18 to 2025), consider:
1. The number of working women nearly doubled to about 201 million.
2. Female Worker Population Ratio rose from 22% to 38%.
3. A rural woman's earnings relative to a rural man's rose from 45% to 53%.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: Working women 104 to 201 million; WPR 22% to 38%; relative pay fell from 53% to 45%, so 3 is wrong.

s: According to the World Bank International Debt Report 2026, the external debt of developing countries in 2025 reached a record
x: Up 5.5% to $9.4 trillion; IDA-eligible countries' debt rose 8.1% to $1.3 trillion.

s: The WMO State of the Climate 2026 report, released at the opening of COP31, put the global average temperature for January–September 2026 above pre-industrial (1850–1900) levels at about
x: 1.47°C above 1850–1900; 2026 among the four warmest years; CO2 426.8 ppm in 2025.

s: In November 2026 the NPPA capped trade margins on the MRP of how many anti-cancer drugs?
x: NPPA (1997, attached office of the Department of Pharmaceuticals) capped trade margins on 137 anti-cancer drugs.

s: The 31st CII Partnership Summit (12–13 November 2026) was held at
x: Held at Visakhapatnam (Andhra University Engineering College grounds), like the 30th edition in 2025.

s:
Consider the following about the CII Partnership Summit:
1. It has been held annually since 1995.
2. It is organised by CII in association with DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
3. The 2026 edition was its 25th edition.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: Annual since 1995, with DPIIT; the 2026 Visakhapatnam edition was the 31st.

s: At the 31st CII Partnership Summit, Andhra Pradesh signed 109 MoUs worth about
x: 109 MoUs worth ₹9.02 lakh crore with over 2 lakh jobs (PTI, 13 Nov 2026); ₹86,522 crore was the pre-summit regional tally.

s: During the 31st CII Partnership Summit, Andhra Pradesh earmarked 5,000 acres near which city for the space sector?
x: 5,000 acres near Tirupati for space; Agnikul Cosmos (₹510 crore) and Hathor Rockets (₹250 crore) proposals.

s: The CM of Andhra Pradesh proposed a 'WIPO–Andhra Pradesh Academy' in a meeting at Visakhapatnam with
x: He met WIPO DG Daren Tang; the academy is for IPR training and WIPO help for GI tags.

s:
Consider the following about WIPO:
1. The WIPO Convention was signed at Stockholm in 1967.
2. It became a UN specialised agency in 1974.
3. Its headquarters is in Geneva.
4. India became a member in 1947.
Which of the above are correct?
x: Signed Stockholm 14 July 1967, in force 1970, UN agency 1974, HQ Geneva; India joined in 1975.

s: Japan's JERA agreed (Nov 2026) to buy about 70,000 tonnes a year of green ammonia from AM Green's project at
x: JERA–AM Green: 70,000 t/yr green ammonia from Kakinada; Japan also plans a second Japanese Industrial Cluster in AP (first at Sri City).

s: COP31 of the UNFCCC opened on 9 November 2026 at
x: COP31: Antalya, 9–20 Nov 2026; COP30 was at Belém.

s:
Assertion (A): Australia's Chris Bowen leads the negotiations at COP31 though Türkiye hosts it.
Reason (R): Under the compromise at COP30, Türkiye holds the COP31 Presidency while Australia acts as 'President of Negotiations'.
Choose the correct option.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
x: Murat Kurum (Türkiye) is COP31 President; Bowen is President of Negotiations under the COP30 Belém compromise.

s:
Consider the following about the '35-by-35' Global Electrification Pledge:
1. It aims to raise electricity's share of global final energy consumption to 35% by 2035.
2. It is a flagship initiative of the Turkish COP31 presidency.
3. It is a legally binding protocol under the Paris Agreement.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: Introduced at Bonn (June 2026) by the COP31 presidency; voluntary and non-binding.

s: The Global Renewables and Energy Efficiency Pledge, which aims to triple renewable capacity to 11,000 GW by 2030, was launched at
x: COP28 Dubai pledge: triple RE to 11,000 GW and double the efficiency-gain rate by 2030.

s: The UNFCCC entered into force on
x: Adopted 9 May 1992, in force 21 March 1994; India ratified 1 Nov 1993; 16 Feb 2005 is the Kyoto Protocol.

s: G7 foreign ministers met on 10–11 November 2026 in
x: Paris, under France's 2026 G7 presidency; the 53rd summit (2027) is in the USA.

s: The 'Seoul Declaration' (Nov 2026) was adopted at the 13th General Assembly of
o: Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia (CICA)
International Conference of Asian Political Parties (ICAPP)
x: ICAPP (launched Manila, Sep 2000; General Assembly every two years) adopted the Seoul Declaration unanimously.

s: The Bay of Bengal Network of Ocean Researchers for Fisheries (BOB-NOR) was launched in November 2026 by India along with three other countries. Which of the following was NOT one of them?
x: Launched by India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and the Maldives (the BOBP-IGO members); Myanmar is only a cooperating non-contracting party of BOBP-IGO.

s: India hosted the first-ever BIMSTEC Maritime Security Exercise (30 Oct – 3 Nov 2026) at
o: Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman and Nicobar Islands
x: Held at Sri Vijaya Puram with the theme 'Shared Seas, Shared Security and Shared Prosperity'.

s:
Consider the following about the BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week observed in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It was held from 1 to 7 November 2026 under India's BRICS Presidency.
2. It is linked to Mission LiFE, launched by India at COP26 in Glasgow.
3. It was organised by the New Development Bank.
Which of the above is/are correct?
x: 1–7 Nov 2026, India's BRICS Presidency, Mission LiFE (COP26, 2021); not an NDB event.

s:
Consider the following about the Financial Action Task Force (FATF):
1. It was established by the G7 in 1989.
2. India became a member in 2010.
3. Its Secretariat is at the OECD headquarters in Paris.
Which of the above are correct?
x: FATF: G7, 1989; 40 members; India 2010; Secretariat at OECD HQ, Paris.

s: Which of the following is NOT on the FATF 'black list' (High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action)?
x: Black list = Iran, North Korea, Myanmar.

s: In November 2026, India completed negotiations with the European Union for association with which programme?
x: Horizon Europe – the EU's research and innovation programme (2021–2027), with 23 associated countries.

s: Under the India–Saudi Arabia bilateral Haj Agreement for 2027, India's Haj quota is
x: 1,75,025 Indians allowed for Haj 2027.

s: The 'Coalition of the Willing', which held its first exercise 'Koalicja' in Poland in November 2026, was set up in March 2025 at the initiative of
x: CotW (35 nations) – UK and France; its Multinational Force–Ukraine is not a NATO force.

s:
Consider the following about the India–Bangladesh Ganga Waters Treaty:
1. It was signed in 1996 when H. D. Deve Gowda was India's Prime Minister.
2. It governs sharing of water at the Farakka Barrage.
3. It is due to expire in December 2026.
Which of the above are correct?
x: 1996 treaty (Deve Gowda – Sheikh Hasina), Farakka sharing, expires 12 Dec 2026.

s:
Match the November 2026 meeting with its venue:
A. COP31 - 1. Shenzhen
B. 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting - 2. Manila
C. 49th ASEAN Summit - 3. Antalya
D. 31st CII Partnership Summit - 4. Visakhapatnam
x: COP31 Antalya; APEC AELM Shenzhen (18–19 Nov); 49th ASEAN Summit Manila; CII Partnership Summit Visakhapatnam.
